text: Hello, I'm Phil.
And I'm Georgie.
Welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 欢迎收听“简单英语”节目。
zh_hant: 歡迎收聽“簡單英語”節目。

text: Remember, you can find the vocabulary from this episode and test yourself with a free worksheet on our website,
zh: 记住，你可以在我们的网站上找到本集的词汇，并通过免费工作表自测，
zh_hant: 記住，你可以在我們的網站上找到本集的詞彙，並透過免費工作表自測，

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi Georgie, how are you?
I'm very well, thank you, Phil.
How are you?
I'm really good.
Today we're going to talk about our families
zh: 今天我们要聊聊我们的家庭
zh_hant: 今天我們要聊聊我們的家庭

text: and particularly our extended families.
Georgie, do you have a big family?
I don't actually.
I have my two parents,
a sister and then outside of that, my family is quite small.
zh: 一个姐姐，除此之外，我家挺小的。
zh_hant: 一個姐姐，除此之外，我家挺小的。

text: I've got one aunt, two uncles,
zh: 我有一位姑妈，两位叔叔，
zh_hant: 我有一位姑媽，兩位叔叔，

text: and only one of my uncles has children,
zh: 而且只有一位叔叔有孩子，
zh_hant: 而且只有一位叔叔有孩子，

text: so I don't have many cousins.
What about you?
Do you have a big family?
Actually, my family is probably similar.
I've got...
I've got a brother, and then I've got two aunts,
zh: 我有一个兄弟，然后我有两位姑妈，
zh_hant: 我有一個兄弟，然後我有兩位姑媽，

text: three uncles.
I've got...
Well, I've got three cousins that I know
zh: 嗯，我有三位认识的表亲
zh_hant: 嗯，我有三位認識的表親

text: and a cousin somewhere lost in Australia.
zh: 还有一个表亲不知在澳大利亚哪里。
zh_hant: 還有一個表親不知在澳大利亞哪裡。

text: Oh wow!
Interesting.
So, we both have quite small extended families.
zh: 所以我们俩的大家庭都挺小的。
zh_hant: 所以我們倆的大家庭都挺小的。

text: Do you see yours much?
Usually only at times,
like at Christmas I'll often see especially my uncles and my aunts.
zh: 比如圣诞节我经常见到，特别是叔叔和姑妈们。
zh_hant: 比如聖誕節我經常見到，特別是叔叔和姑媽們。

text: I see them fairly regularly.
My cousins – yeah, often Christmas or New Year or something like that.
zh: 我的表亲们——嗯，经常在圣诞节或新年之类的见面。
zh_hant: 我的表親們——嗯，經常在聖誕節或新年之類的見面。

text: Same with me, really.
Growing up, my uncle,
who has children who are my cousins,
zh: 他有孩子，也就是我的表亲们，
zh_hant: 他有孩子，也就是我的表親們，

text: they lived quite far away, so it was similar.
zh: 他们住得很远，所以情况类似。
zh_hant: 他們住得很遠，所以情況類似。

text: We only really saw them at Christmas and times like that.
zh: 我们真的只在圣诞节或类似的时候见他们。
zh_hant: 我們真的只在聖誕節或類似的時候見他們。

text: And nowadays I only really see my extended family
zh: 现在我也只在一些场合见我的大家庭
zh_hant: 現在我也只在一些場合見我的大家庭

text: at events like weddings and, sadly, funerals.
zh: 比如婚礼，还有不幸的是葬礼。
zh_hant: 比如婚禮，還有不幸的是葬禮。

text: I'd probably like to see them more.
But this is life.
OK.
Georgie, what about your grandparents?
Have you been close with your grandparents?
Yeah.
So, sadly, I don't have any grandparents left.
zh: 可惜，我祖父母都不在了。
zh_hant: 可惜，我祖父母都不在了。

text: They've all died,
but I was really close with particularly my grandmothers.
zh: 但我特别亲近，尤其是祖母们。
zh_hant: 但我特別親近，尤其是祖母們。

text: Both of them lived quite close to me, so that was really nice.
zh: 她们两位都住得离我很近，所以那挺好的。
zh_hant: 她們兩位都住得離我很近，所以那挺好的。

text: I could spend a lot of time with them.
zh: 我可以在她们身上花很多时间。
zh_hant: 我可以在她們身上花很多時間。

text: They were big personalities – really funny,
zh: 她们个性很强——非常有趣，
zh_hant: 她們個性很強——非常有趣，

text: really loving, caring.
And yeah, I was really close with them.
What about you?
Yeah, I think for me it's kind of similar to your story, really.
zh: 是的，我觉得对我来说，和你的故事挺像的。
zh_hant: 是的，我覺得對我來說，和你的故事挺像的。

text: I don't have any grandparents now, but when I was younger,
zh: 我现在没有祖父母了，但小时候，
zh_hant: 我現在沒有祖父母了，但小時候，

text: the two grandparents that were still alive then, I was quite close to.
zh: 当时还在世的两位祖父母，我和他们很亲近。
zh_hant: 當時還在世的兩位祖父母，我和他們很親近。

text: I used to see my granddad every week.
zh: 我以前每周都见我爷爷。
zh_hant: 我以前每週都見我爺爺。

text: He used to come and do the shopping for my mum,
and I'd see my grandma quite regularly as well.
Yeah, I was quite close with them when I was younger.
zh: 是的，我小时候和他们很亲近。
zh_hant: 是的，我小時候和他們很親近。

text: To talk about our extended families,
we often look at family trees.
That's like a diagram that shows your family history.
zh: 那就像一张显示你家族历史的图表。
zh_hant: 那就像一張顯示你家族歷史的圖表。

text: Have you researched your family tree?
I personally haven't researched my family tree,
zh: 我本人没研究过我的家谱，
zh_hant: 我本人沒研究過我的家譜，

text: but other people in my family have researched it
zh: 但我家里其他人研究过
zh_hant: 但我家裡其他人研究過

text: quite a lot,
so I can see the bits of my family going back lots of generations
zh: 所以我可以看到我家追溯到好多代的部分
zh_hant: 所以我可以看到我家追溯到好多代的部分

text: – going back to Scotland,
to Ireland, to Norway,
to Armenia and places like this.
Wow.
So, your ancestors are from all over the world, it sounds like?
zh: 所以，你的祖先听起来来自世界各地？
zh_hant: 所以，你的祖先聽起來來自世界各地？

text: Quite a few places, yeah.
I also have not researched my family tree,
zh: 我也没研究过我的家谱，
zh_hant: 我也沒研究過我的家譜，

text: but I really would like to because I do know
zh: 但我真的很想，因为我知道
zh_hant: 但我真的很想，因為我知道

text: that my great grandmother was Italian
zh: 我的曾祖母是意大利人
zh_hant: 我的曾祖母是義大利人

text: and my great grandfather was from the US,
so I would love to, kind of,
zh: 所以我很想，某种程度上，
zh_hant: 所以我很想，某種程度上，

text: find some family members from those countries and maybe become close with them.
zh: 从那些国家找到一些家庭成员，也许能和他们亲近。
zh_hant: 從那些國家找到一些家庭成員，也許能和他們親近。

text: I think that would be really interesting to,
zh: 我觉得那样会很有意思，
zh_hant: 我覺得那樣會很有意思，

text: kind of, understand more about my history.
zh: 某种程度上，了解更多的我的历史。
zh_hant: 某種程度上，瞭解更多的我的歷史。

text: If you want to know more about your family history,
zh: 如果你想了解更多你的家族历史，
zh_hant: 如果你想了解更多你的家族歷史，

text: I think you can often look it up.
zh: 我觉得你经常可以查一查。
zh_hant: 我覺得你經常可以查一查。

text: You can...
you can look it up in records in government offices,
zh: 你可以在政府办公室的记录里查，
zh_hant: 你可以在政府辦公室的記錄裡查，

text: but also I think there's a lot of websites
zh: 但我觉得现在有很多网站
zh_hant: 但我覺得現在有很多網站

text: where you can look things up now and find...
zh: 你可以在上面查东西，找到……
zh_hant: 你可以在上面查東西，找到……

text: out your family history – find out about your ancestors.
zh: 你的家族历史——了解你的祖先。
zh_hant: 你的家族歷史——瞭解你的祖先。

text: Yes.
Well, actually, there is a story that my family tells
zh: 嗯，其实，我家人讲过一个故事
zh_hant: 嗯，其實，我家人講過一個故事

text: that I'm not sure is true,
but one of my ancestors
apparently has a connection to royalty
– a big event in history.
But again, I don't know if it's true,
zh: 但再说一次，我不知道是不是真的，
zh_hant: 但再說一次，我不知道是不是真的，

text: so I'd love to look it up and find out the facts.
zh: 所以我很想查一下，找出事实。
zh_hant: 所以我很想查一下，找出事實。

text: I think that would be good.
OK.
Let's recap the vocabulary that we've looked at in this episode,
zh: 让我们回顾一下本集学过的词汇，
zh_hant: 讓我們回顧一下本集學過的詞彙，

text: starting with close.
If you're close with or close to a family member,
zh: 如果你和家人很亲近（close with或close to），
zh_hant: 如果你和家人很親近（close with或close to），

text: then it's someone whom you see a lot and you get on well with.
zh: 那意思是你经常见他们，而且相处得好。
zh_hant: 那意思是你經常見他們，而且相處得好。

text: Your family tree is a diagram or image which shows your family history.
zh: 你的家谱（family tree）是显示你家族历史的图表或图片。
zh_hant: 你的家譜（family tree）是顯示你家族歷史的圖表或圖片。

text: Your ancestors are your relatives from a long time ago.
zh: 你的祖先（ancestors）是很多年前的亲属。
zh_hant: 你的祖先（ancestors）是很多年前的親屬。

text: Lots of people like to look up their ancestors.
zh: 很多人喜欢查找他们的祖先。
zh_hant: 很多人喜歡查詢他們的祖先。

text: If you look something up, you try to find out information – for example,
zh: 如果你查找（look up）某事物，你试着找信息——例如，
zh_hant: 如果你查詢（look up）某事物，你試著找資訊——例如，

text: by searching online or reading books.
That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这就是本期“简单英语”的全部内容。
zh_hant: 這就是本期“簡單英語”的全部內容。

text: We'll be back next week with another episode in easy English.
zh: 下周我们会带着另一期用简单英语做的节目回来。
zh_hant: 下週我們會帶著另一期用簡單英語做的節目回來。

text: And if you want to learn to talk more about your family,
zh: 如果你想学会更多谈论家庭，
zh_hant: 如果你想學會更多談論家庭，

text: we have a collection of episodes all about this topic.
zh: 我们有一系列关于这个话题的节目。
zh_hant: 我們有一系列關於這個話題的節目。

text: Go to bbclearningenglish.com.
Bye for now!
Goodbye!
